service: publish one accepted Koios static candidate through the already-authoritative Cloudflare Worker
precondition: Koios supplies an immutable cutover-candidate artifact whose manifest and delivery-policy bytes match the request digests.
The request binds account 337e54ee6dc7d488933f473204a6d89e, Worker koios-news-primary, route koios.news/*, and origin https://koios.news.
The Resource Brokerage Team holds an unrevoked standing Leader grant and its own restricted Cloudflare resource carrier.
Cloudflare already reports that koios.news/* is bound to koios-news-primary.
move: The provider revalidates the candidate, snapshots the current Cloudflare Worker deployment, updates only koios-news-primary's static assets, probes the exact public routes, and restores the prior Cloudflare Worker version if the new deployment fails its probes.
postcondition: Koios receives an ActivityStreams release receipt binding the exact candidate, unchanged public route, probes, and Cloudflare-to-Cloudflare rollback state, or a typed refusal. Cold Red Gate never becomes an HTTP origin.

standingAuthority.source: the Leader's direction that Koios publish autonomously through Cloudflare and that Cold Red Gate carry persistence only
standingAuthority.attenuation: one exact candidate and one existing Worker per invocation
